verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` as a headless one-shot mode built for CI/CD pipelines, with structured I/O and tiered autonomy, so a team could wire it into a failed-workflow job to diagnose and fix issues. Its CI integration documentation, however, covers PR code review, not repairing failed builds. Missing for 10: a documented feature that triggers automatically on CI workflow failure, evidence of log-based failure diagnosis, evidence that the fix is opened as a proposed pull request, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
